pages.title: The First Useful Trick
pages.text: The Binder follows a two-step rhythm: it joins crystals to crystals and wireless crystals to machines.$(br2)$(bold)Select:$() sneak-use the first endpoint.$(br)$(bold)Connect:$() use the second.$(br)Repeat for each additional link.

pages.title: When Nothing Connects
pages.text: Sneak-use the Binder in the air to clear its selected endpoint; clearing it before each new job prevents accidental links.$(br2)If a link still fails, measure the range and count existing links or wireless targets. A full crystal accepts no more, however many times the Binder is waved at it.
